name: Media auto publication
description: Automatically publishes referenced (unpublished) media entities when the host entity referencing them transitions to published.
project_description:
Have you ever needed to automatically publish media associated with content?

If so, this module is for you!

 This module allows to automatically publish medias when associated entity is being published.

 Say " goodbye " to problems accessing your media rendering when your content is published.

 This module is used to publish all medias referenced with any entity type. 

 Roadmap 
 
 Give possibility to select media bundles to publish. 
 Auto publish media referenced in paragraphs.
